item.tib: lo yi rgyal po keg rigs dang / lam gyi bar chod bzlog pa'i phyir / las kyi kha tshar rmo mdel gzungs / log 'dren ma lus 'joms mdzad
item.note: the first title, the rgya nag keg zlog gzungs, ought to be compared to a similarly titled chos work (although this chos work wasn't located in the catalogs of the derge and lhasa kanjurs, there are a number of popular prints). the word keg (also, skag) is a word for impediments that arise at astrologically determinable times. notice, on fol. 15v, the title in me-nyag (tangut?) language: gyer dun tanta dun. the final text in this section was found by khye'u gnyan-thang at rtsang-po nu-ma'i brag-nag.
